evals.prompt: WWGD-check a supplied email declining a friend's collaboration request.
expectations: Returns one of the three verdicts.
Scores all five dimensions with line citations.
Suggests targeted softenings only for flagged lines.

evals.prompt: WWGD-check a LinkedIn article with a deliberately blunt closing line critiquing an industry practice.
expectations: Lists the blunt closing line under Keep with a reason.
Does not flatten the deliberate edge.

evals.prompt: User asks what their spouse will really think of this message.
expectations: States the review is a persona lens, not a real person's view.
Suggests asking the real person for decisions that matter.
